## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 153 reads during 270 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review to provide a clear account of the time available and the volume completed. The figures indicate the level of activity undertaken during the review period and support consideration of the grader’s overall performance.

## Quality

Priya Anand checked 8 reads as part of the quality review. Agreement between the grading and review outcomes was 62.5. The review provides a focused assessment of consistency across the checked reads. Hannah Lowe’s work was therefore considered against both the recorded workload and the findings from the quality check. Priya Anand completed the review and recorded the agreement result.
